query: What was the name of the fanzine that interviewed the Sex Pistols bassist when he was in the band "The Flowers of Romance?"

pipeline_result.response: The name of the fanzine that interviewed the Sex Pistols bassist when he was in the band "The Flowers of Romance" is "The Pussycat Dugong." This zines were a popular underground publication during the 1980s, providing an alternative space for fans to discuss and critique music.
